question: How many medals did India win in the Commonwealth Games-2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**61**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India won a total of **61 medals** in the Commonwealth Games 2022.
 
• The medal tally included **22 gold**, **16 silver**, and **23 bronze** medals.
 
• India ranked **4th** in the overall medal standings at the Commonwealth Games 2022.
 
• Sports where India excelled included **weightlifting, wrestling, boxing, and badminton**.
